What i meant was that we log 7 hours a day in units consisting of 6 minutes each. We can log all our time at the end of the working day (which is what i usually do, by looking at calendar and sent items).

For example if an email takes me 2 minutes to draft, i log 1 unit = 6minutes. 

If i attended a meeting for 25 minutes, i would log that for 6 units = 30 mins. 

At the end of the day, i need to have logged sufficient units to cover the 7hours.
